description:
Remove sync points from a clip: the ones named in `orders` (the `order` numbers get_clip(select:['sync_points']) lists, which are the N of `<SYNC_MARKER N>` in voiceover_text, for every marker whoever created it), or every one with `all: true`. The words stay; only the pins go, so the clip stops being retimed to those moments.

Use it to move a sync point (remove it, then add_sync_point where it belongs) or to drop the recording's markers before writing a new script. voiceover_batch set_text can do the latter in one step with `clear_sync_markers: true`. Orders are positions, so the remaining markers renumber after a removal: name several in one call, or re-read get_clip before the next. A marker already used by the clip's speech is removed for good when speech is generated again (the reply's `needs_regen`); regenerate with voiceover_batch generate_speech.

all.description: true: remove every sync point on the clip (use instead of orders).

clip_id.description: Clip ID (preferred). If omitted, clip_index is used.

clip_index.description: Zero-based clip index. Ignored if clip_id is provided.

orders.description: Order numbers of the sync points to remove, as get_clip select:['sync_points'] shows them.

name: remove_sync_point
title: Remove sync points
